blocks.content: Thousands of years ago, the Vedas taught us the ultimate lesson of unity and teamwork. Let's read the ancient Rigveda mantra that asks humanity to walk together and speak together.

blocks.title: Passage 1: Walk Together
blocks.content:
समगच्छध्वं संवदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ।
देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे सञ्जानाना उपासते ॥
`` `(Walk together, speak together, let your minds be of one accord. / साथ चलो, साथ बोलो, तुम्हारे मन एक समान हों | / સાથે ચાલો, સાથે બોલો, તમારા મન એક સમાન હોય.)` ``
💡 **Teacher Tip:** Notice how the translation in the backticks helps you pronounce and understand the exact English meaning of the classic text!
📝 **Board Exam Tip:** Always memorize the name of the poet/author. 1-mark questions frequently ask 'Who wrote this poem?'
